insights.text: Sharjah Warriorz win 53% of our simulations.
The toss matters: Sharjah Warriorz win 51% batting first v 55% chasing.
Powerplay: Sharjah Warriorz ~48 runs for 1.5 wickets; no wicket at all in 22% of simulations.
Sharjah Warriorz's first wicket most likely falls around over 3; PVD Chameera is the likeliest to take it (20%).
TL Seifert is Sharjah Warriorz's likeliest top scorer (25%), with a 41% chance of 30+.
Powerplay: Dubai Capitals ~46 runs for 1.9 wickets; no wicket at all in 11% of simulations.
Dubai Capitals's first wicket most likely falls around over 3; C Overton is the likeliest to take it (23%).
F du Plessis is Dubai Capitals's likeliest top scorer (26%), with a 41% chance of 30+.
Waqar Salamkheil leads Sharjah Warriorz's attack: 24% chance of 2+ wickets.
Mustafizur Rahman leads Dubai Capitals's attack: 29% chance of 2+ wickets.
Key duel: Noor Ahmad dismisses PI Walter in 20% of simulations.
